author: sjm41
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**
IPR000672 Tetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase/cyclohydrolase
IPR020630 Tetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase/cyclohydrolase, catalytic domain

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel Nmdmc (Q04448)

* **Description of issue**
Both these entries are annotated with this NADP-specific catalytic term:
GO:0004488 methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity (EC:1.5.1.5)

However, some proteins with this signature are characterized to have the related, but different, NAD-specific activity (e.g. Q04448):
GO:0004487 methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity (EC:1.5.1.15)
 

So I think both these entries may need to be reannotated with the shared parental GO term, which is:
GO:0016646  oxidoreductase activity, acting on the CH-NH group of donors, NAD or NADP as acceptor


Please check, thanks.
title: InterPro2GO issue: IPR000672 & IPR020630

author: blazaropinto
body:
Hi Steven,
Thank you very much, I replaced this term in both entries and added [GO:0035999](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:0035999). The changes will be visible in the next InterPro release.
Best,
Beatriz
